assumptions.label: Tính trên toàn bộ dữ liệu vì câu hỏi không nêu khoảng thời gian

answer.sql: SELECT "Market" AS market, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco GROUP BY "Market" ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT date_trunc('month', strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) AS month, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Top 10 danh mục có doanh thu cao nhất

answer.sql: SELECT "Category Name" AS category, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco GROUP BY "Category Name" ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: Tỷ lệ giao hàng trễ theo phương thức vận chuyển

answer.sql: SELECT "Shipping Mode" AS shipping_mode, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Late_delivery_risk" = 1 THEN "Order Id" END) / COUNT(DISTINCT "Order Id") AS late_rate FROM dataco GROUP BY "Shipping Mode" ORDER BY late_rate DESC

question: Số đơn hàng theo trạng thái giao hàng

answer.sql: SELECT "Delivery Status" AS delivery_status, COUNT(DISTINCT "Order Id") AS orders FROM dataco GROUP BY "Delivery Status" ORDER BY orders DESC

question: Lợi nhuận theo phân khúc khách hàng

answer.sql: SELECT "Customer Segment" AS customer_segment, SUM("Order Profit Per Order") AS profit FROM dataco GROUP BY "Customer Segment" ORDER BY profit DESC

question: 5 khu vực có tỷ lệ giao trễ cao nhất

answer.sql: SELECT "Order Region" AS order_region, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Late_delivery_risk" = 1 THEN "Order Id" END) / COUNT(DISTINCT "Order Id") AS late_rate FROM dataco GROUP BY "Order Region" ORDER BY late_rate DESC LIMIT 5

question: Số ngày giao thực tế và dự kiến theo phương thức vận chuyển

answer.sql: SELECT "Shipping Mode" AS shipping_mode, AVG("Days for shipping (real)") AS avg_real_days, AVG("Days for shipment (scheduled)") AS avg_scheduled_days FROM dataco GROUP BY "Shipping Mode" ORDER BY avg_real_days DESC

SELECT quarter(strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) AS quarter, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco WHERE year(strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) = 2017 GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

question: 5 danh mục có doanh thu cao nhất ở châu Âu

answer.sql: SELECT "Category Name" AS category, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco WHERE "Market" = 'Europe' GROUP BY "Category Name" ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Doanh thu theo ngày giao hàng

answer.sql: SELECT CAST(strptime("shipping date (DateOrders)", '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M') AS DATE) AS ship_day, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco GROUP BY ship_day ORDER BY ship_day

question: Doanh thu theo ngày giao hàng

answer.sql: SELECT CAST(strptime("shipping date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') AS DATE) AS ship_day, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco GROUP BY ship_day ORDER BY ship_day

question: Tại sao doanh thu quý 3 năm 2017 giảm
answer: Doanh thu quý 3/2017 giảm 1283400.00 so với quý 2/2017, từ 9402500.00 xuống 8119100.00. Thị trường Europe giảm nhiều nhất (-639780.25), sau đó là LATAM (-339049.50). Phần lớn mức giảm do số đơn ít đi, từ 5000 xuống 4400 đơn (-1117725.00); giá trị đơn trung bình giảm từ 1880.50 xuống 1845.25 (-165675.00). Nếu số đơn giữ như quý 2/2017, doanh thu quý 3/2017 là 9226250.00.
